catalogTitle: Acme UI — A2UI catalog (compiled from dspack)
catalogDescription: A2UI catalog compiled from the Acme UI dspack v0.4 contract. Component shapes and variant enums are projected onto A2UI-conventional names so existing React registries can render them.
instructions: For layout, use the Column component to organize other components.

action.description: The interaction dispatched when the button is activated.
action.synthNote: A2UI requires a declarative action; Acme expresses this as an onClick handler, which is not representable in a declarative catalog.

label.description: Visible label. Acme buttons never render bare icons.

tone.description: Button intent, projected from Acme tones onto the registry-conventional variant vocabulary.

density.description: Control rhythm, projected one to one from Acme densities.

child.description: The ID of the single child component. Wrap multiple elements in a Column and pass its ID.
child.synthNote: A2UI Card takes exactly one child by ID; Acme InfoCard composes via sub-components (header/title/body/footer), which flatten and collapse to a single, possibly Column-wrapped, child slot.

subCoverage.info-card-header: transparent grouping: children splice inline, in order (subFlatten strategy)
subCoverage.info-card-body: transparent grouping: children splice inline, in order
subCoverage.info-card-footer: transparent grouping: children splice inline, in order

hue.description: Status hue, projected one to one onto the registry-conventional badge variants.

value.description: The bound value of the field.
value.synthNote: A2UI two-way-binds value; Acme NoteField has no value prop in the contract.

resizable.description: Allow the user to drag-resize vertically.

synthesized.description: Displays text content. Synthesized A2UI content primitive (not in the Acme contract).

text.synthNote: A2UI content primitive required to render labels/titles in a surface.

variant.description: A hint for the base text style.

synthesized.description: Arranges children vertically. Synthesized A2UI structural primitive (the Acme contract has no layout component).

children.synthNote: A2UI structural primitive required to compose multiple children.

casualtyComponents.reason: steps is an array prop with no declared item vocabulary (label/done are free-form step data); admitting it would let generation invent step shapes the contract does not govern. Same posture as the canonical dropdown-menu casualty.
